criteria: Candid task action, work-directed or relational eyelines, story-specific emotion. No camera-facing card presentations, posed paired portraits, or lecture-posters replacing crew work.

entries.observedAction: Nazari challenges Demir at his console with a pointed question.
entries.emotion: Demanding skepticism and mild uncertainty.
entries.storyReason: Preserve their relational eyelines and the missing-threshold problem.

entries.observedAction: Farah smiles beside a ReLU lecture graph.
entries.emotion: Investigative concentration on clipping negative inputs.
entries.storyReason: Turn Farah toward the console, entering a test value with one hand while tracing the zero-output segment with a stylus, gaze at the graph.

entries.observedAction: Demir runs a console probe with his eyes on the display.
entries.emotion: Focused expectation.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the live task action and expected-output status.

entries.observedAction: Farah and Nazari stand as a paired portrait displaying a threshold tablet.
entries.emotion: Nazari questions the alert rule while Farah tests it.
entries.storyReason: Seat Farah at the console setting the separate threshold to 0.5 while Nazari leans toward the converted scores, questioning with a raised eyebrow. No held presentation tablet.

entries.observedAction: Demir checks an alert-list disagreement at the console.
entries.emotion: Unease at the unexpected 7741 entry.
entries.storyReason: Keep his attention on the alert list and comparison.

entries.observedAction: Mirza gestures outward beside a presentation hologram.
entries.emotion: Impatient readiness to find out whether the model can learn.
entries.storyReason: Mirza swivels toward the command console and presses its compile control, looking at the ready state with an expectant raised eyebrow.

entries.observedAction: Mirza reads a tablet beside a large explanatory poster.
entries.emotion: Deliberate distinction between configuring and training.
entries.storyReason: Show her checking the actual build, compile, and fit entries on a command workstation, fingertip paused on compile while its weights unchanged note is visible.

entries.observedAction: Demir holds the practice-data card toward the camera.
entries.emotion: Concentration preparing a controlled A/B comparison.
entries.storyReason: Place the data note flat beside the keyboard. Demir leans in to save the two initial states, eyes moving between the monitors.

entries.observedAction: Demir displays a lesson tablet while Mirza poses beside him.
entries.emotion: Demir eager, Mirza asking for evidence on unseen rows.
entries.storyReason: Have them lean across a shared console. Demir points to the fit log, Mirza taps the same-training-rows note with a skeptical look.

entries.observedAction: Farah holds a Train and test card toward the observer.
entries.emotion: Concern at Sample 7741 changing rank before a separate test.
entries.storyReason: Farah studies the two saved-state screens, then writes Train and test in a notebook laid on the console, with a thoughtful frown toward the rank-changed notice.

entries.observedAction: Farah points back at a board while facing the observer.
entries.emotion: Curiosity about the unknown reading.
entries.storyReason: Turn her whole seated body toward the bench. She adjusts a calibration selector and checks the test-reading monitor, brows knit, without looking out.

entries.observedAction: Farah presents a weighted-sum lecture diagram.
entries.emotion: Concentration as she checks the contribution calculation.
entries.storyReason: Over the side of the lab bench, Farah writes 0.26 into her working notebook while comparing the weighted-sum diagnostic on a nearby monitor.

entries.observedAction: Demir presses a console control while Farah watches his work.
entries.emotion: Tentative focus and attentive supervision.
entries.storyReason: Keep the working eyelines and physical console contact.
entries.peerReason: The outward-facing tablet/card content cannot be read by its holder. Remove back-facing label or place the comparison artifact on the working surface facing its reader.

entries.observedAction: Open notebook is held toward the camera as a teaching prop.
entries.emotion: Quiet satisfaction after checking the arithmetic.
entries.storyReason: Lay the notebook on the bench and have Farah underline the final 0.26, leaning over her calculation, stylus set down nearby.

entries.observedAction: Nazari watches the stable calibration readings while holding her mug.
entries.emotion: Skepticism during an extended observation.
entries.storyReason: Keep her attention on the monitor and the quiet watch.

entries.observedAction: Demir is working but Farah is a camera-facing folded-arm portrait.
entries.emotion: Demir puzzled, Farah intent on locating the missing axis.
entries.storyReason: Have Farah lean beside his chair and inspect the error on the same monitor, one hand braced on the desk, while Demir pauses above the keyboard.

entries.observedAction: Demir reads his tablet while Farah watches his reaction.
entries.emotion: A small moment of understanding shared with Farah.
entries.storyReason: Keep the tablet facing its reader and both eyelines connected.

entries.observedAction: Demir types while monitoring the pending shape task.
entries.emotion: Focused concentration.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the console contact and task-directed gaze.

entries.observedAction: Centered Demir holding a tablet reads as an isolated portrait.
entries.emotion: Careful verification that values stayed unchanged.
entries.storyReason: Show Demir from a side three-quarter view comparing the expanded array on the console to a tablet resting flat on the desk, tapping one corresponding row.

entries.observedAction: Demir poses with a notebook against his chest beside saved scores.
entries.emotion: Deflation when random outputs reveal training is still needed.
entries.storyReason: Seat him close to the saved-run screen, notebook open on his lap, pencil paused and eyebrows raised at 0.49, 0.53, 0.51.

entries.observedAction: Nazari stands with folded arms beneath a floating diagram.
entries.emotion: Skeptical inspection of an untrained model.
entries.storyReason: Have Nazari pause mid maintenance at the engineering console, one hand on its open service panel, looking critically at the bridge model status.

entries.observedAction: Nazari holds a tablet beside a teaching poster with no active task.
entries.emotion: Careful scrutiny of the parameter total.
entries.storyReason: Nazari leans over a desk terminal, scrolling the layer summary and marking the 528-parameter middle layer on a work sheet laid flat.

entries.observedAction: Demir places a layer tile on the working architecture board.
entries.emotion: Intent attention to the assembly.
entries.storyReason: Preserve tile placement, hand contact, and gaze toward the task.

entries.observedAction: Nazari poses with a rolled sheet in front of an arithmetic poster.
entries.emotion: Dry satisfaction at a checked total.
entries.storyReason: Unroll the sheet onto the engineering bench and have Nazari pencil-check the three parameter counts with her gaze lowered to the work.

entries.observedAction: Demir writes the model count while Nazari studies the pending training note.
entries.emotion: Demir intent, Nazari unconvinced that assembly finishes the work.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the active writing and relational observation.

entries.observedAction: Demir slumps at his keyboard with his head in his hand.
entries.emotion: Overwhelmed by manually deriving all parameter gradients.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the frustration and working posture while grounding the displays.

entries.observedAction: Demir poses by a diagram with an open notebook.
entries.emotion: Relief as the reverse dependency becomes understandable.
entries.storyReason: Have him trace the actual dependency backward on the engineering touchscreen while reading his notes laid on the desk, body facing the work.

entries.observedAction: Demir types and compares two work screens.
entries.emotion: Careful verification.
entries.storyReason: Keep active keyboard contact and gaze on the result fields.

entries.observedAction: Nazari faces the viewer with a closed book and stopwatch.
entries.emotion: Practical satisfaction with automatic differentiation.
entries.storyReason: Have her check elapsed time at a side console, eyes on the computed gradient entry, putting the stopwatch down beside an open log.

entries.observedAction: Demir rubs his neck under Nazari’s questioning look.
entries.emotion: Sheepish relief after the shortcut becomes clear.
entries.storyReason: Preserve their shared eyelines and distinct reactions.

entries.observedAction: Mirza faces the observer behind a decorative console.
entries.emotion: Demand for evidence beyond the training performance.
entries.storyReason: Mirza leans across the command table and selects the unseen evaluation report, eyes fixed on the result that needs scrutiny.

entries.observedAction: Mirza displays two card boxes toward the camera.
entries.emotion: Deliberate separation of training and test evidence.
entries.storyReason: Have Mirza sort the two data trays onto a command desk while looking down at their labels, with the evaluation display beside her.

entries.observedAction: Demir operates the console and glances toward Mirza.
entries.emotion: He seeks a decision while she studies the evidence.
entries.storyReason: Keep the live task and relational eyelines.

entries.observedAction: Mirza gestures at a display while Farah poses holding a tablet.
entries.emotion: Concern about the failures hidden by an overall score.
entries.storyReason: Both inspect individual mistakes on the workstation; Mirza selects one row while Farah annotates the corresponding evidence on a desk pad.

entries.observedAction: Farah compares a note with the console and writes.
entries.emotion: Quiet concern at the ambiguous sample.
entries.storyReason: Preserve her downward focus and the physical comparison.
entries.peerReason: The outward-facing tablet/card content cannot be read by its holder. Remove back-facing label or place the comparison artifact on the working surface facing its reader.

entries.observedAction: Nazari poses with a tool beside generic graphs.
entries.emotion: Impatience at 673 parameters with no direction chosen.
entries.storyReason: Restage her leaning into a console and selecting one weight to inspect, one hand on a real control and eyes on the pending direction.

entries.observedAction: Nazari presents a tool in her palm beside a curve.
entries.emotion: Practical concentration on one useful step.
entries.storyReason: Have her adjust a console dial while comparing w=5 and proposed w=4 in the one-weight diagnostic, with the tool put down.

entries.observedAction: Demir presses a control while watching the update display.
entries.emotion: Eager focus.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the task-directed body and eyeline while replacing unsupported screens.

entries.observedAction: Demir shows a graph tablet outward beside Nazari.
entries.emotion: Demir notices an unstable step, Nazari reacts skeptically.
entries.storyReason: Both lean over a desk display comparing rates; Demir moves toward pause while Nazari points at the diverging values.

entries.observedAction: Demir selects a task row while Nazari looks at him.
entries.emotion: Demir pleased with one update, Nazari dryly aware of 672 left.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the relational reaction and console action.

entries.observedAction: Farah leans over the bench and measures the prediction-label gap.
entries.emotion: Intent curiosity about how to quantify the error.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the close inspection and stylus contact.

entries.observedAction: Farah poses as a lecturer pointing at an equation.
entries.emotion: Concentration converting one error to its squared contribution.
entries.storyReason: Have her write the squared-error calculation on a bench notebook while checking the prediction and label on her working monitor.

entries.observedAction: Demir works but Farah stands as a posed notebook holder.
entries.emotion: Demir engaged, Farah checking the chosen loss against the output type.
entries.storyReason: Farah bends slightly toward the console, consulting her open notebook on the desk and pointing to the probability-input row while Demir types.

entries.observedAction: Frontal Farah lays out two number cards for the viewer.
entries.emotion: Concern at the weak saturated MSE gradient.
entries.storyReason: Show her seated sideways at the bench comparing two gradient readouts, circling the much smaller MSE value on her workpad while looking at the readings.

entries.observedAction: Farah writes on the lab glass while Demir watches her reasoning.
entries.emotion: Thoughtful caution about a baseline before celebrating.
entries.storyReason: Keep the shared eyelines and writing action, no camera gaze.

entries.observedAction: Demir stands folded-arm in front of a loss poster.
entries.emotion: Overconfident satisfaction before checking validation.
entries.storyReason: Show him mid-run at the console, then leaning toward the validation line as concern starts to interrupt his smile.

entries.observedAction: Demir holds index cards while posing beside two curves.
entries.emotion: Realization that training and validation tell different stories.
entries.storyReason: Spread the notes on the desk and have him compare the two curves at the keyboard, pencil hovering over their divergence.

entries.observedAction: Demir uses a run control while Nazari watches his monitor.
entries.emotion: Anticipation under skeptical supervision.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the working interaction and natural shared focus.

entries.observedAction: Demir holds two chart sheets toward the observer.
entries.emotion: Unease at a favorable training curve with worse validation.
entries.storyReason: Put both logs on the bench and show him sliding one beside the other, frowning at the differing last entries.

entries.observedAction: Demir pins the run evidence to the engineering board.
entries.emotion: Determination to keep an inspectable record.
entries.storyReason: Preserve the active pinning and gaze to the paper.
